name: Auto Play
description: The game plays itself. Simple hazard-lookahead bot for cube sections.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the bot on or off.

practice-only.name: Practice Mode Only
practice-only.description: Only play by itself in Practice Mode, so normal runs stay legit.

lead-time.name: Lead Time
lead-time.description: How early (in seconds) it jumps before a hazard. Raise if it jumps too late, lower if too early.
